_comment: Korean for every ui.* key. Hand written — GGG supplies item names, not interface text.
This file is an INPUT to build-ko-dictionary.py, which merges it with data/ko-items.json.
Keeping it separate is what stops a regeneration from wiping the hand written half.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the generator.
The ui.category.* terms are not invented: each was read out of the measured GGG Korean
static response (docs/design/00-api-contract.md §6) by pairing an English item or group
label with its Korean counterpart. 화폐/갑충석/성유/관측기/룬 접목/징조/두카트/휩싸는 수정 all
ui.category.djinnCoin is deliberately ABSENT. Neither GGG static response contains the
word Djinn in any form, so there is no measured Korean term, and poe.ninja lists zero items
under that type. Writing a guess here would look identical to a verified term and nobody
would know to revisit it — the same reason 00-api-contract.md §6.4 forbids filling
unresolved item slugs with English. The chain falls to the on-disk en and shows 'Djinn Coin'.
